known_shortcuts.T2.share_on_this_ladder_market: controls are sampled one market at a time, so the value is always 1 for a control (excluded)
known_shortcuts.T2.hours_first_buy_to_tnews: controls are matched on first-buy time within 24-72 h, so this cannot separate classes much (kept; check its univariate AUC)
known_shortcuts.T3b.*: placebo markets are crypto-price and weather markets: volume shape, price path and buyer mix differ by market type, not by informed trading
known_shortcuts.T3.log_usdc_*: twins are matched on total volume decile, so total volume is controlled only coarsely; pre-cut volume can still differ by market age
known_shortcuts.T1.log_buy_usdc_pre / log_market_usdc_pr: selection by the sources, not construction: sources flag large bets, so pre-cut size alone ranks positives highly (univariate AUC 0.93-0.98). A detector that learns size learns what the press notices.
known_shortcuts.T2.prior_net_long_win_rate / n_prior_mar: partly construction: control pools exclude Orca- and Inca-flagged wallets (A6.10), which removes many strong past traders from the controls; and partly selection (sources flag fresh wallets). Univariate AUC 0.82-0.88.
